description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that manages a RecyclerView fragment and a logging interface, including menu options to toggle log visibility and initialize logging chain.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages a RecyclerView fragment and logging UI, providing menu options to toggle logs and initialize logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and adds RecyclerViewFragment if no saved state.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu, toggling log visibility and title based on mLogShown.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection to toggle log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment.
